headline: Freelance Copywriter & Digital Marketing Specialist | SEO-Driven Content & Growth Strategy
summary: Bilingual professional with a Bachelor of Business Administration and extensive experience in digital marketing, growth strategy, and technical content creation. Proven track record in managing high-performance campaigns across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, with a strong focus on SEO, conversion optimization, and data-driven storytelling. Skilled in researching complex industries, including finance, tech, and e-commerce, to produce engaging, ROI-focused content that aligns with brand voice and client guidelines. Experienced in remote collaboration and deadline-driven delivery, ensuring high-quality output for diverse audiences.

experience.title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
bullets: Developed and executed data-driven content and campaign strategies for major financial and crypto platforms, focusing on SEO and conversion optimization.
Created high-quality, engaging copy for landing pages, blog posts, and digital assets, ensuring alignment with brand voice and client-specific guidelines.
Conducted in-depth research on financial markets, target audiences, and competitors to inform content strategy and improve organic reach.
Managed full-funnel KPIs including ROAS and conversion rates, using insights to refine copy and improve customer acquisition.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Authored and managed content for Telegram communities and social media channels, driving user engagement and growth across MENA, EU, and Asian markets.
Collaborated with KOLs and influencers to produce high-impact campaign content, ensuring accurate and compelling messaging.
Adapted complex technical and financial topics into accessible, engaging copy for diverse audiences.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer & Creative Strategist
bullets: Delivered 150+ projects across 12+ countries, combining technical expertise with creative strategy to produce user-centric web content and interfaces.
Integrated server-side tracking and analytics to support data-driven content decisions and performance optimization.
Maintained zero-vulnerability deployment standards with full technical documentation, ensuring clarity and precision in all deliverables.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Freelance Copywriter position at Coalition Technologies. With a background in digital marketing and a Bachelor of Business Administration, I bring a unique blend of strategic thinking and creative writing skills. My experience managing SEO-driven campaigns for financial and tech platforms has honed my ability to research complex topics and translate them into engaging, conversion-focused content. I am proficient in adapting to diverse brand voices and meeting strict deadlines in remote settings. I am eager to contribute my skills to your team and deliver high-quality content that drives results for your clients.

screening.q: Do you have excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills?
Do you have 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience?
Do you have a strong understanding of SEO writing best practices?
Can you research unfamiliar industries and technical topics?
Do you have experience in specialized industries such as tech, finance, or marketing?
Do you have a portfolio featuring published work?
